title: Senior Java developer
description:
**Är du en erfaren Javautvecklare som söker nya utmaningar?**
 Hos B3 Innovation får du möjligheten att arbeta i en miljö där innovation och samarbete står i fokus. Vi söker dig med djup kunskap inom Java och som trivs i en dynamisk och inkluderande arbetsmiljö.
   

  

**Om rollen som Javautvecklare på B3 Innovation**
 Som utvecklare hos oss kommer du att:
   

  

* Utveckla högkvalitativa och skalbara lösningar.
* Samarbeta med ett tvärfunktionellt team av experter.
* Delta i design och arkitektur av nya system.


**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har god erfarenhet och arbetat som utvecklare under en längre tid. Du som har hunnit både göra misstag och även lära av dem. Förhoppningsvis tycker du om att arbeta i team, dela med dig av dina kunskaper och vill fortsätta att lära dig nytt.
   

  

 Våra krav för att du ska passa i denna roll:
   

  

* Du behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.
* Du har minst 8 års erfarenhet av Javautveckling.
* Du har god kunskap att jobba med Java, Kotlin, Spring, Microservices (gärna i CI/CD-miljö)
* Du har god kunskap att jobba med olika ramverk som React, Angular och Vue.
* Du har ett öga för detaljer och brinner för att leverera kvalitativa lösningar.
* Du är bekväm med moderna utvecklingsmetoder som Agile och DevOps.
* Har du dessutom kunskaper inom Techlead blir vi extra glada!


 Varför B3 Innovation?
   

  

* Innovativ Kultur: Vi uppmuntrar kreativitet och nya idéer.
* Inkluderande miljö: Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter en arbetsplats där alla känner sig välkomna.
* Balans och flexibilitet: Flexibilitet är centralt, vilket gör att du kan forma din arbetsdag för att få livspusslet att gå ihop. Vi förstår vikten av balans mellan arbete och fritid och erbjuder därför flexibla arbetstider.
* Gemenskap: Hos oss blir du en del av ett stöttande team som arbetar tillsammans för att nå gemensamma mål. Det handlar inte bara om “jobb jobb jobb” hos oss. Vi anordnar allt från tech-workshops till sociala aktiviteter som stickcaféer, spelkvällar och AW.


**Om B3 Innovation**
 Vi är kända för vårt fokus på innovation och förmåga att leverera värde till våra kunder. Genom att kombinera djup teknisk expertis med en stark förståelse för våra kunders verksamhet, skapar vi lösningar som verkligen gör skillnad. Vår kultur bygger på öppenhet, samarbete och en passion för teknik.
   

  

 Vi prioriterar personlig utveckling och erbjuder verktyg som B3 Academy, TechTalks och "Lunch & Learn" för att du ska kunna växa.
   

  

 Upptäck möjligheterna med B3 Innovation. Som utvecklare får du arbeta inom spännande branscher som media, bank och finans, energi, offentlig sektor, telekom och e-handel. Oavsett om du optimerar TV-sändningar, utvecklar digitala banktjänster eller skapar smarta hem, hjälper vi dig att hitta det perfekta uppdraget som matchar dina intressen.
   

  

 Våra toppbetyg i medarbetarundersökningar visar att nöjda kollegor är kärnan i vår framgång. Är du redo att kliva in i en miljö där utveckling och trivsel går hand i hand?
   

  

 Som sagt, välkommen till B3 Innovation – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
   

  

**Är du redo att ta nästa steg?**
 Skicka in din ansökan idag och bli en del av vårt engagerade och innovativa team!
   

  

 Om du är mer nyfiken på oss så kan du läsa mer om oss här: https://www.b3.se/innovation
   

  

 Om du har funderingar så hör gärna av dig till Kenneth Andersson på +46706678050 alternativt mail kenneth.andersson@b3.se

title: Fullstack-utvecklare
description:
Till HiQ söker vi nu erfarna Fullstack-utvecklare som vill vara med och skapa innovativa och användarvänliga lösningar för våra kunder. I rollen kommer du fokusera på backend-utveckling och bidra till projekt som gör skillnad för samhället. Du blir en viktig del av ett kompetent team där ni tillsammans hanterar utvecklingen av framtidens digitala tjänster.
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 Som Fullstack-utvecklare kommer du främst att arbeta med backend-utveckling, men även ha möjlighet att bidra med frontend-kompetens när det behövs. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Backend: Java (Spring, Spring Boot) eller .NET/C#
* Frontend: Javascript/Typescript (React.js, Vue.js eller Angular)
* Molnlösningar: AWS, GCP eller Azure


 Du kommer att delta i hela utvecklingsprocessen från design och utveckling till test och driftsättning, samt bidra med tekniskt innovativa lösningar.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har:**
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av fullstack-utveckling
* Ingenjörsexamen i datateknik, teknisk fysik, elektroteknik eller motsvarande
* Svenskt medborgarskap och är flytande i svenska och engelska


**Meriterande:**
* Erfarenhet av DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes och CI/CD-pipelines
* Erfarenhet av molnplattformar (AWS, Azure, GCP)


**Vi erbjuder dig**
* Utmanande uppdrag både ute i våra kunders organisationer samt i vår egen regi, där HiQ har helhetsansvar för projekten.
* Möjlighet att delta i och leda utvecklingen av våra kunders framtida tjänster som förenklar människors vardag
* Kunniga kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sina kunskaper och erfarenheter
* En kreativ arbetsmiljö med möjlighet att utvecklas som människa, kollega och bli bättre på det du redan är bäst på!
* Du blir en del av ett värderingsstyrt bolag som värdesätter glädje och gemenskap och hittar på mycket roligt tillsammans.


**Varför HiQ**
 Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklat världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. HiQ har alltid fokuserat på två saker: att ha kul på jobbet och att leverera lösningar utöver förväntningar - det är vad som driver oss framåt! Vi HiQare är stolta över att ha en kultur som präglas av
 **resultat** 
 ,
 **ansvar, enkelhet** 
 och
 **glädje** 
 . Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå våra gemensamma mål och strävar efter att hjälpa varandra att fortsätta växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du utöver chansen att utveckla din egen kompetens också möjlighet att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.
   

  

*I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå urvalsfrågor, intervjuer, tekniska tester, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!*

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Join Tendfor, part of AnywhereNow, and help shape the next generation of cloud-based customer experience solutions.** 
 We are looking for two Full-Stack Developers to join our Stockholm product team and build resilient, intuitive features for a mature SaaS platform.
 



  





**About Tendfor** 




 Tendfor develops a cloud-based contact centre and attendant platform for Microsoft Teams. Our product supports modern customer interactions across voice and digital channels and is built on Microsoft technologies. Tendfor is part of AnywhereNow, an international customer experience software company.
 



  





 We are strengthening our product development team in Sweden and are looking for developers who want to take end-to-end responsibility for features, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continue to scale a mature SaaS product.
 



  





**The opportunity** 




 This is a hands-on product development role spanning frontend, backend, integrations, data, and cloud services. You will design intuitive user experiences and build resilient services and APIs used in business-critical customer environments.
 



 You will join a collaborative team with short decision paths and close contact with product management, QA, support, and operations. We value pragmatic engineering, strong quality practices, continuous learning, and people who take initiative.
 



  





**What you will do** 




 • Design, build, test, and maintain features across the Tendfor platform.
 



 • Develop modern web applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
 



 • Build and maintain distributed backend services using Azure Service Fabric.
 



 • Create REST APIs, integrations, and database solutions.
 



 • Use Microsoft Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Copilot in the daily development workflow.
 



 • Apply AI-driven development practices to implementation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, and troubleshooting.
 



 • Collaborate with product, UX, QA, support, and operations from idea through to production.
 



 • Contribute to architecture, technical design, code reviews, roadmap refinement, CI/CD, and reliable releases.
 



 • Improve automated testing, observability, security, performance, and maintainability.
 



 • Investigate complex issues that cross application and infrastructure boundaries, and share knowledge across the team.
 



  





**Our technology environment** 




  





 Our technology environment includes:
 



**• Core development:** 
 C# • .NET • ASP.NET Core
 



**• Frontend:** 
 Blazor • JavaScript • TypeScript • HTML • CSS
 



**• Cloud and data:** 
 Microsoft Azure • Azure Service Fabric • Azure SQL
 



**• Integration:** 
 Azure Service Bus • REST APIs • Real-time communication
 



**• Delivery:** 
 Visual Studio • Azure DevOps • Git • CI/CD
 



**• Microsoft ecosystem:** 
 Microsoft Teams • Microsoft Graph • Enterprise identity
 



**• AI-enabled workflow:** 
 GitHub Copilot • AI-assisted development practices
 



  





*You do not need to know every technology from day one. Strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly matter most.* 




  





**What we are looking for** 




 • Professional experience in full-stack or product software development.
 



 • Strong C# and .NET skills, with experience building web applications.
 



 • Frontend development experience and a good understanding of usability and responsive interfaces.
 



 • Experience designing or consuming APIs and working with relational databases.
 



 • Familiarity with cloud development, preferably Microsoft Azure.
 



 • Professional experience using Microsoft Visual Studio.
 



 • Experience with GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted tools, paired with responsible review and validation of AI-generated code.
 



 • The ability to analyse complex problems and independently drive work to completion.
 



 • A quality mindset, including readable code, automated testing, and constructive code reviews.
 



 • Good collaboration and communication skills in English.
 



  





**It would be a plus if you have** 




 • Experience with Blazor, distributed systems, or Azure Service Fabric.
 



 • Experience building multi-tenant SaaS products or enterprise software.
 



 • Knowledge of Azure DevOps pipelines, infrastructure, deployment automation, or observability.
 



 • Experience with Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, telephony, or contact centre solutions.
 



 • Experience with real-time applications, messaging, SignalR, or event-driven architecture.
 



 • An interest in AI-assisted development and AI-enabled customer experience solutions.
 



 • The ability to communicate in Swedish.
 



  





**How we work** 




**• Own the outcome:** 
 Take responsibility from problem definition through delivery and follow-up.
 



**• Keep it pragmatic:** 
 Choose maintainable solutions and avoid unnecessary complexity.
 



**• Build quality in:** 
 Make testing, security, review, and operational readiness part of development.
 



**• Learn and share:** 
 Improve continuously and help colleagues succeed.
 



**• Collaborate openly:** 
 Challenge ideas respectfully and make decisions together.
 



  





**What we offer** 




 • A key role in the continued development of an established SaaS product.
 



 • Influence over architecture, engineering practices, and product evolution.
 



 • A modern, Microsoft-focused technology environment.
 



 • Close collaboration with experienced colleagues in Sweden and internationally.
 



 • A hybrid working model with the Stockholm team.
 



 • Opportunities to broaden your full-stack, cloud, integration, and product development skills.
 



 • A workplace that values initiative, accountability, inclusion, and practical problem-solving.
 



  





**About AnywhereNow and Tendfor** 




 Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global provider of Enterprise Dialogue Management and customer experience solutions. With colleagues across 22 countries, the company serves more than 2,000 enterprise customers, including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town.
 



  





 Tendfor joined the AnywhereNow group in December 2024, Tendfor continues to innovate as part of a global customer experience software organisation focused on Microsoft Teams, AI and cloud communications.
 



  





 Our solutions combine Microsoft Teams, cloud technology, and AI-driven capabilities to help organisations improve interactions with customers and employees. Our international culture is built around innovation, customer focus, collaboration, and accountability.
 



  





**Some last notes** 




 AnywhereNow and Tendfor are committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We accept difference and thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.
 



 Please note that we have a background check policy. The background check differs by country and position. If you would like to know more, our recruiters will be happy to answer any questions.
 



  





**Information Security Responsibilities** 




 All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:
 



 • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures, and guidelines at all times.
 



 • Protecting company, customer, and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or loss.
 



 • Using company systems, devices, and networks in a secure and compliant manner.
 



 • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches, or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.
 



 • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.
 



 • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.
 



  





**Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.**

title: Software Engineers
description:
*MSAB is a global leader in digital forensic technology for mobile device examination and analysis. The MSAB vision is to empower every investigation with digital forensic solutions – for a safer world. A core value is to run an ethics-driven company with innovation and results. The sole focus of MSAB is on delivering high quality digital forensic solutions to collect, review, analyze and manage data. MSAB is a trusted partner to Law Enforcement, Defence Forces, Government Agencies and Forensic Laboratories in democratic countries throughout the world enabling them to investigate crime, gather intelligence, investigate fraud and fight corruption.*
 To our new Stockholm office we’re looking for two engineers to join our Unicore team. You enjoy building systems that are not only functional, but also efficient, scalable, and thoughtfully designed. This is a chance to work with technology with a purpose – to create a safer world.
   

  

**The job**
 At MSAB, the Unicore team is responsible for the core of our digital forensics platform, including UNIFY and the XRY file format (Core API). We’re now working on the next generation of UNIFY, and this is an opportunity to help shape it from the inside.
   

  

 In this role, you will work with core system development where performance and reliability are critical. You’ll be dealing with distributed systems and data-intensive workloads, contributing to architectural decisions with long-term impact, and exploring how to best leverage hardware such as CPU and GPU.
   

  

 Our current tech stack includes C99, C++20, and C# (.NET 8/10), along with gRPC, SQLite and PostgreSQL, running across both Windows and Linux environments.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We believe you will thrive in this environment if you have a genuine interest in programming and problem-solving, and if you care about performance, clean design, and user experience. You likely enjoy systems engineering, think in terms of trade-offs, and prefer solving meaningful problems over fitting into rigid roles. An appreciation for simplicity and keeping dependencies lean will serve you well.
   

  

**Your Experience**
 You will benefit from your experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices, containerization with Docker, or cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure which is considered a plus.
   

  

 You will be part of a focused team working close to the core of the product, where your decisions matter and your code has real impact.
   

  

 Interested, or know someone who might be? Reach out or apply — we’d love to connect.
   

  

 There is much more to talk about, like values, our growth plans, technology choices etc., but we save that for the interview.
   

  

 Welcome to apply now!
   

  

 For more information about MSAB, please visit: http://www.msab.com
   

  

 What we can offer
   

  

 Create a safer world with us!
   

  

 As one of the world’s leading digital forensics companies, MSAB leads the way in pioneering advancements that contribute to making our world safer.
   

  

 Your work at MSAB will bridge the gap between technology and justice. You will be inspired to go beyond your comfort zone, and you will deal with challenging and meaningful projects. When you join us, you become part of a global team that aspires to create a safer digital future, one breakthrough at a time.
   

  

 We can offer you an exciting work environment, where we value being innovative, acting ethically and delivering results in everything we do while our customers' needs are at the center. We are proud to be a fast-growing international company with more than 20+ nationalities and we work with things that really make a difference.
   

  

 Every day at MSAB is an opportunity to redefine the future of digital forensics.
   

  

 Are you up for the challenge?

title: AI-Utvecklare
description:
Vill du utveckla AI- och ML-tjänster som faktiskt går i produktion och gör verklig skillnad för människor och djur? Hos oss får du kombinera modern fullstackutveckling med avancerad AI, från NLP och chatbotar till bildigenkänning, i en miljö där du är med och formar både arkitektur och lösning.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Du blir en central del i ett team som bygger intelligenta tjänster ovanpå en modern Azure-plattform. Här jobbar du både med klassisk systemutveckling och hands-on AI-utveckling. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan backend i .NET, frontend i React och AI-komponenter i Python, och du är med hela vägen från idé och prototyp till produktion och vidare optimering.
   

  

 IT och affären jobbar nära tillsammans, vilket betyder att du snabbt ser effekten av det du bygger. Du samarbetar tätt med andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att våra lösningar hänger ihop från frontend till backend – och att AI-funktionaliteten faktiskt används och skapar värde.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Bygga moderna frontend-lösningar med React, TypeScript och microfrontend-arkitektur
* Jobba testdrivet och bidra till hög kvalitet i koden
* Designa och implementera integrationer med både synkrona och asynkrona mönster
* Vara delaktig i mjukvaruarkitektur och tekniska vägval
* Bygga och optimera CI/CD-pipelines med Azure och Azure DevOps
* Automatisera miljöer och infrastruktur med Bicep
* Utveckla och implementera avancerade AI-lösningar med fokus på NLP, intelligenta system och bildigenkänning
* Bygga, integrera och optimera chatbotar och språkmodeller (inklusive generativ AI)


 För att lyckas i tjänsten tror vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av generativ AI och av att ha deployat applikationer i produktion
* God kunskap av fullstack-utveckling med .NET och React
* Vana av testdriven eller testfokuserad utveckling
* Erfarenhet av integration mot synkrona och asynkrona gränssnitt/mönster
* Förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur och hur man bygger skalbara lösningar
* Erfarenhet av att bygga CI/CD-pipelines med Azure som målplattform
* Kunskaper i Bicep
* Flytande i både svenska och engelska


 Som person är du drivande och resultatfokuserad, med en stark nyfikenhet på ny teknik. Du kan växla mellan att arbeta självständigt och i team, och du har ett gott självledarskap. Du håller ordning och reda, dokumenterar på en lagom nivå och bidrar till en kultur där man delar kunskap, utmanar gamla sanningar och tillsammans bygger smartare lösningar.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter:**
 Rekryterande chef: Poja Daroui, poja.daroui@agria.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Mirek Swartz, mirek.swartz@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Ellinor Jatéus, ellinor.jateus@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Agria är ett helägt dotterbolag till Länsförsäkringar och finns idag i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Danmark, Storbritannien, Tyskland, Frankrike och Irland. Vårt svenska kontor ligger på Gärdet i Stockholm, men vårt hjärta och verksamhet sträcker sig långt utanför Sveriges gränser. Med en tydlig tillväxt agenda fortsätter vi att expandera internationellt, driva innovation och utveckla digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för djurägare. Ett exempel är vårt dotterbolag Agria Vet Guide, som erbjuder digital rådgivning och gör det enklare att hjälpa fler djur snabbare.
   

  

 Vi är marknadsledande i Norden inom djur- och husdjursförsäkringar, med en tydlig vision: att bli Europas mest omtyckta och pålitliga partner för djurägare. Vårt ledarskap handlar inte bara om marknadsandelar; det handlar om att skapa trygghet för både djur och människor, och att göra livet med djur enklare och roligare.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Sana
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments people - not replaces them.
   

  

 We bring this mission to life through two products. Sana Agents provide a seamless way to access all your company’s apps, knowledge, and data, enabling AI agents to do real work so teams can process and act on information at unprecedented scale. Sana Learn is an AI-powered learning hub that combines the simplicity of a modern learning platform with intelligent features like an AI tutor, automated content generation, and interactive apps, making knowledge not just accessible but actionable.
   

  

 We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers from companies like Google, Spotify, Apple, and Databricks, united by deep technical excellence and rapid iteration. Our tools already help over a million people learn and work better across hundreds of leading enterprises - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You'll build the core agent infrastructure that powers Sana's mission to bring superintelligence to work. This is a greenfield opportunity to define how AI agents plan, reason, and execute across enterprise environments—building systems that reliably handle real-world complexity at scale. You'll work at the intersection of agent architecture, context-, tool- and prompt engineering, and production infrastructure.
   

  

 In this role, you will
   

  

* Architect multi-step planning, orchestration, and tool routing for agents
* Implement code generation agents and sandboxed code execution
* Engineer memory, state, and context packing/grounding strategies
* Balance latency, quality, and cost controls for agent execution
* Develop safe fallbacks, graceful degradation and robust error handling
* Collaborate with platform and search teams to deliver reusable agent infrastructure
* Establish safety guarantees and measurable quality improvements


 #SanaJobs
   

  

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications:**
* 3+ years of software engineering experience building production backend or platform systems.
* 3+ years of experience in TypeScript, with a strong track record of writing reliable, maintainable services.
* 3+ years of experience with distributed systems, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and service-oriented architecture.
* 3+ years of experience designing systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, observability, and maintainability.


**Other Qualifications:**
* Experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications in production.
* Experience building agent platforms or AI infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of the low-level details of the OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic LLM APIs, including tool calling, system prompt caching, etc.
* Familiarity with LLM application patterns, including tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory and context management, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop systems.
* Experience building and running machine learning systems in production, including compiling training and test datasets, building training pipelines, evaluating models, and detecting and handling drift (neural networks, Gaussian models, Thompson sampling, etc.).
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent quality and safety, including hands-on use of platforms such as Langfuse or LangSmith.
* Familiarity with vector databases, prompt and context engineering, and experimentation tooling.
* Experience working with sandbox environments such as Modal, and designing strict access control models to keep user data safe and encrypted at all times.
* Experience running services in Kubernetes-based environments on GCP or equivalent cloud platforms.
* Comfort working with Postgres and Redis in high-throughput, low-latency service contexts.
* Contributions to open source TypeScript projects.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, make strong technical tradeoffs, and drive projects from concept to production.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, and AI research teams.

title: Senior Consultant within Business Transformation
description:
**Company Description**
**Shape the Future of Digital Transformation**
 Do you want to help global brands transform their business through cutting-edge technology? Join our
 **ERP & Digital Transformation practice** 
 and play a key role in driving programs and projects that matter. From Industrials and Manufacturing to Consumer Products, you’ll work on initiatives that redefine how businesses operate.
   

  

 You’ll be part of a close-knit global team, collaborating with colleagues across the Nordics, the Netherlands, the UK, Ireland, and the US—sharing expertise and learning from the best.
   

  

**Join us if you want to:**
* Work alongside experts in ERP and technology-enabled change, advising decision-makers at global brands
* Take on complex business challenges and gain responsibility early, accelerating your career growth
* Collaborate with colleagues across the Nordics, Europe, and the US in a truly international environment


**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**
 The main goal of this role is to work closely with our clients in innovative, integrated business, IT and cultural change processes, where you also play a leading role in managing stakeholders and in supporting and managing organizational change. As a Senior Consultant, you like to contribute to sales initiatives and Thought Leadership, with the aim of further expanding competencies and propositions that help to acquire new assignments and clients, and to expand our existing clients and of course, the growth of your own career at PA.
   

  

  

* Lead or support the development of Target Operating Models and business architecture blueprints, that support large-scale change programs within organizations.
* Technical and operational resilience, analysing end-to-end operations (people, process, technology) that help organizations protect their reputation and comply with regulations.
* Transformation planning, building combined business and technology roadmaps that support the planning and execution of organization-wide transformations.
* Lead or support ERP strategy development, requirements definition, and vendor selection.
* Manage ERP implementations, including System Integrator oversight.


**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For**
* 5-7 years of experience in consulting or transformation projects
* Experience in ERP-enabled transformation programmes.
* Experience in working on behalf of clients in ERP programmes, bridging client needs and technical (vendor) delivery.
* Familiarity with process standardisation and optimisation methodologies.
* Proven capability in change management.
* Strong consulting skills and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of ERP platforms (Oracle, SAP, Dynamics, or simlar)
* Ability to work across sectors and adapt to varied client environments.
* Experience in business process design, data migration, and reporting strategy
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities


**Additional Information**
 We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future.
   

  

 As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity.
   

  

 Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.
   

  

 We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport.
   

  

 Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.
   

  

 We believe that diversity makes us a stronger firm and look to employ people with different ideas, styles and skillsets. This diversity stimulates a rich, creative environment – one in which our people develop, and our clients enjoy enduring results. We’re committed to recruiting, promoting and rewarding our people solely based on their ability to contribute to PA’s goals, without regard to their sex, race, disability, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age or marital status.
   

  

***We welcome international applications, but we are unable to offer sponsorship for work permits, so you will need to have the full right to live and work in Sweden.***
 As part of our recruitment process we use Sterling ADP to carry out background screening checks towards the end of the recruitment process.

title: Product Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Du som vill bygga säkra, uppkopplade produkter från första idé till färdig lösning kommer att trivas här. Hos oss på HiQ i Stockholm får du kombinera djup teknisk spets med nyfikenhet på hur produkterna används i verkligheten.
   

  

 Som Product Cybersecurity Engineer arbetar du i hjärtat av tekniskt komplexa produkter där mjukvara, hårdvara och säkerhet möts. Du är med genom hela produktlivscykeln, från koncept och arkitektur till lansering, vidareutveckling och avveckling. Rollen har tydligt fokus på inbyggda system och produktnära cybersäkerhet och du samarbetar nära kundernas utvecklingsteam. En vanlig dag kan du fördjupa dig i TARA, skissa på en säkerhetsarkitektur för ett inbyggt system, stötta team kring secure boot och OTA-strategier och samtidigt ha tekniska dialoger med produktägare.
   

  

 Du kommer att:
   

  

* Utveckla och påverka inbyggd mjukvara och system i tekniskt komplexa produkter
* Arbeta med produktrelaterad cybersäkerhet genom hela produktens livscykel
* Genomföra hot och riskanalyser, till exempel TARA, och omsätta resultaten i konkreta säkerhetsåtgärder
* Utforma och implementera säkerhetslösningar för inbyggda system, inklusive till exempel secure boot, kryptografi säker kommunikation
* Säkerställa efterlevnad av relevanta cybersäkerhetsstandarder och regulatoriska krav i olika branscher
* Samverka med tvärfunktionella team, kunder och leverantörer och bidra till kravhantering, systemarkitektur och teknisk dokumentation


 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Akademisk utbildning inom till exempel maskin, mekatronik, cybersäkerhet, datateknik eller likvärdig teknisk inriktning
* Minst cirka fyra års erfarenhet av inbyggd produktutveckling i kombination med cybersäkerhet
* Erfarenhet av programmering i C, C++, Rust, Python och eller arbete med inbyggda Linux system
* God förståelse för diverse säkerhetskontroller såsom secure boot, kryptografi, säker kommunikation, OTA uppdateringar samt hårdvara mjukvara gränssnitt
* Praktisk erfarenhet av relevanta cybersäkerhetsstandarder och riktlinjer, till exempel CRA, ISO SAE 21434, IEC 62443, IEC 81001 eller NIST SP 800-serien
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift, samt svenskt medborgarskap
* Mycket meriterande om du har certifieringar som CISSP eller CSSLP, erfarenhet från reglerade branscher och konsulterfarenhet med intresse för både teknik och affär


 Som person är du prestigelös, nyfiken och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap, samtidigt som du uppskattar att lära av andra.
   

  

 Varför HiQ?
   

  

 Hos HiQ får du kombinera djup teknisk spets med friheten att utforska nya områden tillsammans med kollegor som brinner för teknik och säkerhet. Du arbetar i skarpa uppdrag där dina beslut syns i verkliga produkter, och du kan växa mot till exempel ledande roller i säkerhetskritiska utvecklingsprojekt eller renodlade expertroller inom produktcybersäkerhet. I vardagen har du nära till kollegor med erfarenhet från fordonsindustri, medicinteknik och industri och ni stöttar varandra, delar lärdomar och driver utvecklingen framåt tillsammans.
   

  

 Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklar världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi har alltid haft två tydliga fokus: att ha roligt på jobbet och att leverera lösningar som överträffar förväntningarna – det är det som driver oss framåt. Som HiQare är vi stolta över en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå gemensamma mål och vi lägger stor vikt vid att hjälpa varandra att växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du inte bara möjlighet att bygga din egen kompetens, utan också chansen att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.

title: Test Automation Engineer

* En kreativ arbetsmiljö med möjlighet att utvecklas som människa, kollega och bli bättre på det du redan är bäst på!
* Du blir en del av ett värderingsstyrt bolag som värdesätter glädje och gemenskap och hittar på mycket roligt tillsammans.

title: Software Engineer, Platform (Runtime)
description:
**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**About The Apps Platform**
 The Lovable Apps Platform is what makes those generated apps actually run in production. The moment a user hits deploy, the Apps Platform takes over — provisioning the database, handling user auth, storing files, serving the app over a custom domain, capturing logs, and metering usage. It's the full backend and hosting layer for every app built on Lovable, designed so creators never have to think about infrastructure to ship something real.
   

  

 The Apps Platform is growing fast, and we're investing heavily in each layer of the stack — building deeper ownership over the services that power our users' apps so we can move faster, scale better, and shape the product experience us and our users actually want.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for software engineers with a platform mindset to work on the app runtime, deployment pipeline, and the composable managed services we purchase and operate. Some foundational services we buy from 3p partners, others are not available for purchase and you would be the first in the world to build them at scale. You'll keep these services running reliably, manage vendor relationships and migrations, and ensure operational excellence across the stack.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the app hosting and deployment pipeline — the runtime that serves user applications in production
* Manage and operate composable managed services for storage, logging, workflows etc
* Build and maintain custom domains infrastructure, ensuring reliable SSL provisioning and DNS management at scale
* Drive vendor evaluation, onboarding, and migration as we continue decomposing our platform from a bundled BaaS to best-of-breed individual services
* Establish operational excellence practices: monitoring, alerting, incident response, runbooks, and capacity planning across all managed services


**What We're Looking For**
* Experience building and operating distributed systems
* Ideally 6+ years of experience in running and developing
* Strong background in platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure operations
* Deep understanding of multitenant app hosting infrastructure, container orchestration, or edge runtimes
* Vendor management experience: evaluating services, negotiating contracts, planning migrations, and holding vendors accountable for SLAs
* Operational mindset: you think in uptime, latency percentiles, cost-per-request, and blast radius


**Nice to Have**
* Experience building and operating massively multitenant control planes
* Experience operating Cloudflare Workers, Pages, R2, or D1 at scale
* Hands on experience contribution to cloud infrastructure or CNCF projects (kubernetes, worked, envoy)
* Familiarity with ClickHouse or other columnar databases for log analytics
* Experience with managed database services (such as Supabase, Neon, AWS Aurora, Google Cloud SQL etc)
* Cost optimization experience — you've driven meaningful infrastructure cost reduction


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
   

  

* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS.
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.
* DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform.


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Teknisk Team Manager inom IT-utveckling till Svea Bank

title: Postdoktor i biostatistik
description:
****Vill du bidra till medicinsk forskning av toppkvalitet?****




 Institutionen för medicinsk epidemiologi och biostatistik bedriver forskning inom epidemiologi och biostatistik inom ett brett spektrum av områden inom biomedicinsk vetenskap. Institutionen är bland de största inom sitt område i Europa och har särskilt starka forskningsprofiler inom psykiatrisk, cancer-, reproduktiv, pediatrisk, farmakologisk, genetisk och geriatrisk epidemiologi, ätstörningar, precisionsmedicin, och biostatistik.
   

  





 En del av framgången för institutionen beror på vår samarbetsanda, där en stor bidragande faktor är att forskare vid institutionen delar och samfinansierar gemensamma resurser (som t.ex. IT och en tillämpad biostatistikgrupp). Institutionen ligger på campus Solna. Mer information finns på http://ki.se/meb.
   

  





 Postdoktorn kommer att ingå i ett team lett av Dr Viktor Ahlqvist, med fokus på perinatal epidemiologi och avancerad epidemiologisk metodutveckling. Gruppen använder nationella administrativa och kliniska data för att studera kliniskt och folkhälsovetenskapligt relevanta frågeställningar. Forskningsmiljön är analytiskt avancerad och starkt samarbetsinriktad, med särskilt fokus på metodutveckling med klinisk och translationell relevans. Gruppen både tillämpar och utvecklar moderna metoder inom kausal inferens, med ett särskilt intresse för automatiserade analytiska lösningar och metoder som kan skalas till stora datamaterial och studier över flera länder.
   

  





****Din roll****




 Som postdoktor i biostatistik i gruppen kommer du att leda metodutvecklingsprojekt med relevans för forskningsområdet. Ett särskilt fokus kommer att ligga på metodologisk utveckling inom läkemedelsepidemiologi. Arbetet omfattar hela forskningsprocessen, från idéutveckling och studiedesign till genomförande, analys, vetenskaplig publicering och spridning av resultat.
   

  





 Du kommer även att bidra till handledning av juniora medarbetare i gruppen och förväntas successivt ta ett ökat ansvar för vetenskapligt ledarskap och självständigt driva egna forskningsinitiativ.
   

  





 Detta är en tidsbegränsad anställning om två år med möjlighet till förlängning.
   

  





****Vem är du?****




 Färdigheter:
 


* Du ska ha doktorsexamen inom biostatistik, statistik, epidemiologi eller ett närliggande område.
* Du ska ha mycket god förmåga att kommunicera i tal och skrift på engelska.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling av statistisk programvara är meriterande, särskilt erfarenhet av utveckling i Stata.

title: Senior Game Designer | Candy Crush Saga
description:
**Craft:**
 Games Design & Production
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Are you a systems thinker and creative architect? Do you dream of crafting features that connect everything together: where player progress feels meaningful, social interactions spark joy, and every reward motivates another level?
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented and collaborative Senior Game Designer to join the Gameplay team in Candy Crush Saga, shaping the future of our metagame features and systems in one of the most successful live games in the world. You’ll bring deep systems thinking to the features behind progression, competitive events, and social loops that touch millions of players every day.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

 As a Senior Game Designer, you’ll design and optimize metagame features and systems, such as progression, competitive events, and social loops, that bring structure, meaning, and delight to the player journey and support the team’s key strategic bets. You’ll own these features and systems end to end, from strategic framing and prototyping through implementation, live release, and iteration, and you’ll be able to explain not just what a feature does but why its specific values, pacing, and reward structure are the right solution.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, engineers, and other game designers to define, prototype, and deliver features and systems that are easy to use, deeply satisfying, and seamlessly connected to the core game.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and evolve metagame features and systems, such as progression, competitive events, and social loops, that deepen engagement and reflect a strong understanding of player behavior and motivation.
* Own metagame features, systems, and strategic bets end-to-end, from concept and specification through implementation, live release, and iteration.
* Use quantitative and qualitative data and player insights to inform, balance, and tune features and systems against key metrics.
* Translate strategic goals, KPIs, and player insights into clear, structured, and actionable design documentation, explaining why specific values, triggers, and pacing are the right solution.
* Partner with live ops teams to design and optimize features that maximize live events’ impact and player retention.
* Collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams (product, UX, engineering, data) to deliver high-quality, fun, and impactful experiences.
* Work with fellow designers to ensure metagame features and systems integrate cohesively with core gameplay and the wider game ecosystem.
* Stay informed on F2P trends in monetization and player engagement, and share relevant insights with the team.
* Bring fresh thinking and genre-leading ideas to the Candy Crush metagame, staying ahead of trends in casual F2P design.


**Skills**
* Proven Experience in Live F2P Metagame Design (Required): You have hands-on experience designing and running live metagame features and systems, such as progression, achievements, or social mechanics, for casual mobile free-to-play games. You understand the rhythms of live content, player motivation, and what keeps players coming back day after day.
* Feature Ownership & Strategic Delivery: You’ve owned or significantly contributed to metagame features or systems that drove long-term engagement in live casual games, from strategic framing through live release and iteration.
* Systems & Economy Thinking: You understand how to design and balance interconnected features and systems, progression, rewards, pacing, and player motivation, and can reason about how a change in one system ripples through the wider economy and player behavior.
* Data-Driven & Insight-Led: You’re comfortable diving into quantitative and qualitative player data, identifying patterns, and turning insights into meaningful design improvements.
* Player-Centric Mindset: You design for joy and motivation, and you’re excited to test, learn, and iterate with real player feedback.
* Collaborative & Structured Communicator: You’re a clear communicator who builds alignment across disciplines and helps teams rally behind great ideas.
* Craft Leadership & Mentorship: You share learnings with other designers, mentor less experienced colleagues, and help raise the bar for metagame design across the team.


* Experience working on match-3, merge, or social mobile games with large, active live playerbases.
* Experience designing progression systems, achievements, seasonal structures, or social gameplay loops at scale.
* Familiarity with economy balancing, live ops systems, or content pipelines.
* Knowledge of match-3 puzzle mechanics and how core gameplay systems (levels, boosters, board mechanics) connect to metagame and live features.


**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Founding Hardware Engineer
description:
Cota Robotics puts robots to work in retail stores. They take on the repetitive, time-consuming jobs like inbounding goods, replenishing shelves and sorting stock, currently mostly overnight. They're driven from our control room in Stockholm and increasingly run on their own. We raised a €1.92M pre-seed in August 2026 and are live with retailers in Sweden and Finland. We're a small team based at Sankt Eriksgatan in Stockholm, where half the office is our own dark store.

You'll own the physical robot: from concept and CAD through prototyping and 3D printing to manufacturing and assembly at scale. You'll see your work running in stores within weeks.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Concept and visualize new products and subsystems
* Model structures, mechanisms and enclosures in CAD
* Prototype rapidly and iterate from what you see in stores

**What We're Looking For**
* Attitude first: high agency, you spot the problem and ship the fix without being told
* A strong track record in hardware design, or an unreasonable appetite to build one
* Comfortable in a fast-moving, unfinished environment where the plan changes
* Ready for long weeks when it matters and demos that have to work tomorrow
* Fluent in English; Swedish is a plus
* You must already have the right to work in Sweden, as unfortunately we're not able to offer visa sponsorship at our current stage


**Why join**
* A founding role with ownership of the hardware
* Meaningful equity
* See your designs running in real stores within weeks
* Shape the next version of the robot

title: Data Analyst
description:
**For a Sustainable Future Together**
 Coop is Sweden's largest cooperative and a leading player in the grocery retail sector, with over 4 million members. We focus heavily on sustainability and work to create a greener and more just future by offering sustainable products and services.
   

  

 We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to creating a more inclusive and successful workplace. Therefore, we welcome everyone, regardless of gender, age, background, or ethnic origin.
   

  

**Coop Sverige – Together we make food-Sweden sustainable**
 At Coop, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our customers, improve our operations and make better decisions. With over 4 million members and data across stores, logistics and digital channels, we have both the scale and the opportunity to create real impact. To add to this, our data platform runs on an architecture suitable for providing agentic analytics!
   

  

 Within our AI & Business Intelligence organization, we have built a modern analytics platform that we are proud of – and we are now looking for a
 **Senior Data Analyst** 
 to help us turn even more of that data into action.
   

  

**Om Tjänsten**
 You will join our Analytics team within AI & Business Intelligence, working closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and stakeholders across Coop.
   

  

 As a Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of technology and business. The role is not only about answering questions with data, but understanding the problem behind the question, challenging assumptions and determining what we should actually do with the insight.
   

  

 You will have considerable freedom in how you approach problems. We believe in building reusable, scalable solutions in code rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Translate business challenges into analytical questions, solutions and recommendations aid all of Coop in decision making
* Work with large datasets across customer behaviour, sales, assortment, logistics and digital channels and develop scalable and reusable solutions with any too you see fitting the purpose.
* Build analytical agents, dashboards, ad hoc analyses or any other data product that democratizes our data.
* Challenge existing questions and ways of working – moving from “can you analyse this?” towards “this is what we should do.”


***Who are you?***
 We believe you enjoy operating at the intersection of data, technology and business. You are curious enough to dig into the details, but can also step back and understand the bigger picture.
   

  

 You don't see an analysis as finished when the numbers are correct – you want to understand what they mean and what action they should lead to. You are comfortable taking ownership even when the path forward is not completely defined.
   

  

**We believe that you**
* Have experience turning business needs into analytical questions and solutions.
* Are comfortable programming in SQL and Python, with experience of PySpark or similar technologies and have experience working with version control, such as Git.
* Have strong business understanding and can connect analytical findings to concrete actions and can communicate this effectively with any audience.
* Understand fundamental statistical methods and when different analytical approaches are appropriate.


**It’s meritorious if you**
* Have experience from a modern cloud-based data platform or Lakehouse environment.
* Have worked with providing agentic analysis, analytics engineering, BI tools or code-first analytical workflows.
* Have worked in a scale-up, technology company, consultancy or another environment where broad ownership is expected.
* Have experience from retail, e-commerce or another data-intensive consumer business.


**About Us**
 The grocery trade is a stable, long-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.

description:
**Mission** 




 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
 



 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 As a System Verification Engineer, Test Automation, you sit at the boundary between our hardware devices and our software. You build the test infrastructure that automates verification of software updates on our instruments, so new software ships quickly and with high confidence in its safety, performance and compliance. You define the test methods for system-level verification, develop the system tests those methods call for, and then automate them.
 



 You'll join the Verification & Validation team, which supports a wide regulated product portfolio spanning hardware medical devices (instruments), SaMD and health software. The team is small, growing and fast-moving, with real room to shape engineering quality, verification strategy, and how products are built as we scale.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, implement and maintain automated test frameworks and test rigs that exercise firmware and embedded software against the device hardware, sensors and instruments they control, and integrate them into the development and release pipelines.
* Build the tooling and pipelines that verify software updates on our instruments automatically, so new software deploys fast and with high confidence.
* Define test methods and acceptance criteria for system-level verification of our medical devices.
* Plan and execute verification activities, system and regression tests, and produce audit-ready reports.
* Contribute to traceability matrices, V&V plans and design reviews.
* Collaborate closely with Firmware, Electronics, Algorithms, Software, QA/RA and Manufacturing Engineering to make requirements testable and to debug failures across hardware, firmware and software boundaries.

**Why this role matters** 




 Neko's device portfolio is growing faster than manual verification can scale. As a System Verification Engineer, Test Automation you build the automated verification backbone that lets our instruments be updated safely, quickly and with confidence, across every clinic and every country we operate in.

title: Mechatronics Engineer (Entry-level)
description:
Cota Robotics puts robots to work in retail stores. They take on the repetitive, time-consuming jobs like inbounding goods, replenishing shelves and sorting stock, currently mostly overnight. They're driven from our control room in Stockholm and increasingly run on their own. We raised a €1.92M pre-seed in August 2026 and are live with retailers in Sweden and Finland. We're a small team based at Sankt Eriksgatan in Stockholm, where half the office is our own dark store.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You’ll work hands-on with the robot. Grippers, actuators, sensors, wiring, mounts, whatever the robot needs to survive a real store. Some of it will be properly engineered. Some of it needs to work by Thursday. You should be comfortable with both.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, build, and fix electrical and mechanical subsystems on the robot
* Deploy robots into stores and see firsthand where they break
* Turn what you learn in stores into the next version of the hardware
* Work across the whole stack, including electronics, mechanics, wiring, and integration


**What we’re looking for**
* A generalist comfortable across a broad range of components and disciplines
* A tinkerer, maker, or someone who has taken more things apart than they’ve put back together
* Able to make something work in the short term and improve it later without confusing the two
* At home in a chaotic, fast-moving environment
* Ready to learn, even when that means researching unfamiliar issues as they arise
* We expect to fill this role in November or December 2026, so we may not be able to offer an immediate start
* You must already have the right to work in Sweden, as unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa sponsorship at our current stage


**Why join**
* Build on real robots operating in real stores
* Work across disciplines rather than in a narrow silo
* Learn quickly from field deployments and hardware feedback
* Help shape the next version of the system
